ns2:course.label: Computational Tools for Biological Data
ns2:course.description: Fundamental and applied statistics, including probability distributions, parameter estimation, descriptive statistics, hypothesis testing, and linear regression. Statistical methods in genomics including sequence analysis, gene expression data analysis, human genomic variation, regulatory genomics, and cancer genomics. Credit is not given towards graduation for both BIOE 310 and IE 300. Prerequisite: BIOE 210 or MATH 257. Students in the BS-BIOE must take BIOE 210 as the prerequisite.
